logging/field#

Structured fields of log records: JSON members.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

LogFields(JsonField("user", 7), JsonField("ms", 12));
CombinedLogFields(base: common, added: extra).fields();

Description#

Structured fields of log records: JSON members.

Public API#

object LogFields#

object LogFields

Fields form one JSON object of at most 256 members, 32 levels and 1 MiB of compact text, checked once at construction; Json values are immutable.

The members; InvalidLogField for a repeated name.
